name: Industrial sodium chloride
description: A coproduct of lithium carbonate precipitation and magnesium removal; washed salt can feed a chlor-alkali cell.

name: Sodium hydroxide solution
description: Caustic coproduct from brine electrolysis; used in pretreatment and magnesium precipitation.

name: Chlorine gas
description: Toxic chlor-alkali coproduct; sale requires a gas-tight line, scrubber and safety interlocks.

name: Hydrogen gas
description: Flammable chlor-alkali coproduct; route to acid synthesis or a certified gas holder.

name: Hydrochloric acid
description: Produced by controlled synthesis of hydrogen and chlorine; used to elute the loaded DLE sorbent.
